q: 我下班以后常常去公司楼下___篮球。
zh: 我下班以后常常去公司楼下打篮球。
py: wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu cháng cháng qù gōng sī lóu xià dǎ lán qiú
en: After work I often play basketball downstairs from the office.
why: Basketball is a hand ball game, so it takes 打. 踢 is for football and 弹 for keys or strings.

q: 邻居家的孩子每天晚上都在练___钢琴。
zh: 邻居家的孩子每天晚上都在练弹钢琴。
py: lín jū jiā de hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài liàn tán gāng qín
en: The neighbours' child practises the piano every evening.
why: Piano keys are pressed, so the verb is 弹. 打 is for ball games and 拉 for the violin; neither goes with 钢琴.

s: 周末我们去公园踢篮球。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán tī lán qiú
zh: 周末我们去公园打篮球。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
en: At the weekend we go to the park to play basketball.
why: Basketball is a hand ball game, so it takes 打. 踢 is only for football and other kicking games.

q: 楼上的邻居会___小提琴，我们晚上常常能听到。
zh: 楼上的邻居会拉小提琴，我们晚上常常能听到。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū huì lā xiǎo tí qín wǒ men wǎn shang cháng cháng néng tīng dào
en: The neighbour upstairs plays the violin, and we often hear it in the evening.
why: The violin is bowed, so it takes 拉. 弹 is for piano and guitar, and 吹 is for wind instruments.

q: 吃完晚饭，爷爷和邻居在楼下___棋。
zh: 吃完晚饭，爷爷和邻居在楼下下棋。
py: chī wán wǎn fàn yé ye hé lín jū zài lóu xià xià qí
en: After dinner Grandpa plays chess with a neighbour downstairs.
why: Chess is 下棋: the pieces are put down on the board. 打 is for ball games and 弹 for instruments, so neither is said with 棋.

s: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
zh: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
py: tài wǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē huí jiā ba
en: It is too late; let us take a taxi home.
why: 打车 is the normal way to say "take a taxi", with 打 as in hailing one. It is correct even though English uses "take".

q: 我的手机没电了，能借你的手机给家里___个电话吗？
zh: 我的手机没电了，能借你的手机给家里打个电话吗？
py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn le néng jiè nǐ de shǒu jī gěi jiā lǐ dǎ gè diàn huà ma
en: My phone is out of battery. Could I borrow yours to call home?
why: A phone call is made with 打: 打电话. 做 is the English "make" and does not work here, and 发 is for messages and email.

q: 孩子发烧了，医生让他去医院___针。
zh: 孩子发烧了，医生让他去医院打针。
py: hái zi fā shāo le yī shēng ràng tā qù yī yuàn dǎ zhēn
en: The child has a fever, and the doctor told him to go to the hospital for an injection.
why: An injection is 打针. 吃 is for pills and food, so 吃针 is impossible, and 做针 does not exist.

s: 妈妈给孩子穿了一顶红帽子。
s_py: mā ma gěi hái zi chuān le yī dǐng hóng mào zi
zh: 妈妈给孩子戴了一顶红帽子。
py: mā ma gěi hái zi dài le yī dǐng hóng mào zi
en: Mum put a red hat on the child.
why: A hat is put on the head, so it takes 戴. 穿 is for clothes and shoes that you get into, so 穿帽子 is wrong.

q: 公园里有几个小孩在___足球。
zh: 公园里有几个小孩在踢足球。
py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu jǐ gè xiǎo hái zài tī zú qiú
en: A few children are playing football in the park.
why: Football is kicked, so it is 踢足球. 打足球 is a typical learner error: 打 is for games played with the hands or a racket.

q: 天气冷了，出门要___厚外套。
zh: 天气冷了，出门要穿厚外套。
py: tiān qì lěng le chū mén yào chuān hòu wài tào
en: It is getting cold; wear a thick coat when you go out.
why: A coat is something you get into, so it takes 穿. 戴 is for hats and glasses, and 系 is for ties or belts.

q: 他的眼睛不好，平时都___着一副眼镜。
zh: 他的眼睛不好，平时都戴着一副眼镜。
py: tā de yǎn jing bù hǎo píng shí dōu dài zhe yī fù yǎn jìng
en: His eyesight is poor, so he usually wears glasses.
why: Glasses are put on the face, so they take 戴. 穿眼镜 is a classic error: 穿 is only for clothes and shoes you get into.

s: 他穿着一双旧皮鞋，戴着一块旧手表。
zh: 他穿着一双旧皮鞋，戴着一块旧手表。
py: tā chuān zhe yī shuāng jiù pí xié dài zhe yī kuài jiù shǒu biǎo
en: He is wearing an old pair of leather shoes and an old watch.
why: Both verbs are right: shoes take 穿 and a watch takes 戴, even though English says "wear" for both.

q: 医生进手术室以前，要先___上口罩。
zh: 医生进手术室以前，要先戴上口罩。
py: yī shēng jìn shǒu shù shì yǐ qián yào xiān dài shàng kǒu zhào
en: Before going into the operating room the doctor first puts on a mask.
why: A mask is put on the face, so it takes 戴 (戴上 "put on"). 穿 is for clothes, and 围 is for a scarf wrapped round the neck, not for a mask.

q: 面试的时候，他___了一条蓝色的领带。
zh: 面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
py: miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
en: At the interview he wore a blue tie.
why: A tie is tied, so it takes 系 (read jì). 穿 is only for clothes you get into, so 穿领带 is wrong.

s: 下班以后，我骑公共汽车回家。
s_py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ qí gōng gòng qì chē huí jiā
zh: 下班以后，我坐公共汽车回家。
py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ zuò gōng gòng qì chē huí jiā
en: After work I take the bus home.
why: You sit inside a bus as a passenger, so it takes 坐. 骑 is only for things you sit astride, like a bike or a horse.

q: 你的鞋带松了，快蹲下来___好。
zh: 你的鞋带松了，快蹲下来系好。
py: nǐ de xié dài sōng le kuài dūn xià lái jì hǎo
en: Your shoelace is loose; crouch down and tie it quickly.
why: Laces are tied, so 系好 (jì hǎo). 戴 is for hats and glasses and 穿 for clothes and shoes, so neither can fasten a lace.

q: 商店里的裙子很漂亮，我想___上试试。
zh: 商店里的裙子很漂亮，我想穿上试试。
py: shāng diàn lǐ de qún zi hěn piào liang wǒ xiǎng chuān shàng shì shi
en: The skirts in the shop are lovely; I want to try one on.
why: A skirt is something you get into, so 穿上. 戴 is for hats, glasses and watches, and 系 for things you tie.

s: 我哥哥每天开自行车去公司。
s_py: wǒ gē ge měi tiān kāi zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
zh: 我哥哥每天骑自行车去公司。
py: wǒ gē ge měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
en: My older brother cycles to the office every day.
why: You ride a bike by sitting astride it, so 骑. 开 is for driving a car or other vehicle with an engine.

q: 他手腕上___着一块很贵的手表。
zh: 他手腕上戴着一块很贵的手表。
py: tā shǒu wàn shàng dài zhe yī kuài hěn guì de shǒu biǎo
en: He is wearing a very expensive watch on his wrist.
why: A watch is put on the wrist, so it takes 戴. 穿手表 is wrong: 穿 is only for clothes and shoes you get into.

q: 我的运动鞋湿了，今天只能___皮鞋去上班。
zh: 我的运动鞋湿了，今天只能穿皮鞋去上班。
py: wǒ de yùn dòng xié shī le jīn tiān zhǐ néng chuān pí xié qù shàng bān
en: My trainers are wet, so today I can only wear leather shoes to work.
why: Shoes are something you put your feet into, so 穿. 戴 is for things worn on the head, face or wrist, and 系 would only fit the laces.

q: 我家离公司很远，我每天___地铁上班。
zh: 我家离公司很远，我每天坐地铁上班。
py: wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn yuǎn wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
en: My home is far from the office, so I take the subway to work every day.
why: A passenger sits inside the subway, so it is 坐. 骑 is for things you straddle, and 开 is only for the driver, which a subway rider is not.

s: 下午的会已经开了两个小时了。
zh: 下午的会已经开了两个小时了。
py: xià wǔ de huì yǐ jīng kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí le
en: The afternoon meeting has already been going for two hours.
why: 开会 is the fixed pair for holding or attending a meeting, and the duration 两个小时 follows the verb 开了.

q: 我家离超市很近，我常常___自行车去买菜。
zh: 我家离超市很近，我常常骑自行车去买菜。
py: wǒ jiā lí chāo shì hěn jìn wǒ cháng cháng qí zì xíng chē qù mǎi cài
en: My home is close to the supermarket, so I often cycle there to buy food.
why: You sit astride a bike, so it is 骑自行车. 开 is for driving vehicles with an engine or steering wheel, and 开自行车 is a typical learner error.

q: 我爸爸在一家公司当司机，每天都___公司的车接送经理。
zh: 我爸爸在一家公司当司机，每天都开公司的车接送经理。
py: wǒ bà ba zài yī jiā gōng sī dāng sī jī měi tiān dōu kāi gōng sī de chē jiē sòng jīng lǐ
en: My dad is a driver at a company and drives the company car to pick up and drop off the manager every day.
why: A driver drives the car, so 开. 坐 would make him a passenger, which contradicts 当司机, and 骑 is for bikes and horses.

s: 晚上我喜欢在家读电视。
s_py: wǎn shang wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā dú diàn shì
zh: 晚上我喜欢在家看电视。
py: wǎn shang wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā kàn diàn shì
en: In the evening I like to watch TV at home.
why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 is for reading text aloud or studying at a school, never for watching.

q: 房间里太黑了，你能帮我把灯___一下吗？
zh: 房间里太黑了，你能帮我把灯开一下吗？
py: fáng jiān lǐ tài hēi le nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ dēng kāi yī xià ma
en: It is too dark in the room; could you turn on the light for me?
why: Switching a light on is 开灯. 关 would switch it off, which makes no sense in a dark room, and 打灯 is not a Chinese phrase for this.

q: 别当真，我只是跟你___玩笑。
zh: 别当真，我只是跟你开玩笑。
py: bié dàng zhēn wǒ zhǐ shì gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào
en: Don't take it seriously; I was only joking with you.
why: Teasing someone is 开玩笑, a fixed phrase with 开. 讲 and 说 work with 笑话 (tell a joke) but not with 玩笑.

s: 他感冒了，所以今天在家喝汤吃药。
zh: 他感冒了，所以今天在家喝汤吃药。
py: tā gǎn mào le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān zài jiā hē tāng chī yào
en: He has a cold, so today he is at home drinking soup and taking medicine.
why: Soup is drunk (喝汤) and pills are eaten (吃药). Chinese uses these mouth verbs where English says "take medicine".

q: 我们明天上午要___飞机去上海出差。
zh: 我们明天上午要坐飞机去上海出差。
py: wǒ men míng tiān shàng wǔ yào zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
en: Tomorrow morning we are flying to Shanghai on a business trip.
why: Passengers sit inside a plane, so it is 坐飞机. 开飞机 is for the pilot, and 骑 is for things you sit astride.

q: 办公室太热了，我们___空调吧。
zh: 办公室太热了，我们开空调吧。
py: bàn gōng shì tài rè le wǒ men kāi kōng tiáo ba
en: The office is too hot; let us switch on the air conditioning.
why: Switching on the air conditioning is 开空调, and 开 also means "switch on". 关 means switch off, which does not help a hot room.

q: 我头疼得很厉害，下午想去医院___病。
zh: 我头疼得很厉害，下午想去医院看病。
py: wǒ tóu téng de hěn lì hai xià wǔ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn bìng
en: My head hurts badly; this afternoon I want to go to the hospital to see a doctor.
why: Going to be examined is 看病, the same 看 as in 看医生. 吃 and 喝 are for the mouth: they need food, drink or medicine as an object, not 病.

s: 饭馆里不能喝烟，请到外面去。
s_py: fàn guǎn lǐ bù néng hē yān qǐng dào wài miàn qù
zh: 饭馆里不能抽烟，请到外面去。
py: fàn guǎn lǐ bù néng chōu yān qǐng dào wài miàn qù
en: You can't smoke in the restaurant; please go outside.
why: Cigarettes are 抽 ("draw on"), not 喝. 喝 is for liquids such as water, tea and soup.

q: 这种药饭后___，一次两片。
zh: 这种药饭后吃，一次两片。
py: zhè zhǒng yào fàn hòu chī yī cì liǎng piàn
en: Take this medicine after meals, two tablets at a time.
why: Pills are eaten in Chinese: 吃药. 抽 is for cigarettes and 打 for injections, so neither fits tablets.

q: 医生说他身体不好，不能再___烟了。
zh: 医生说他身体不好，不能再抽烟了。
py: yī shēng shuō tā shēn tǐ bù hǎo bù néng zài chōu yān le
en: The doctor says his health is poor and he must not smoke any more.
why: Cigarettes are 抽烟 ("draw"). 喝烟 and 吃烟 are English-driven errors: 喝 is for liquids and 吃 for food.

s: 妈妈在厨房里办晚饭。
s_py: mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ bàn wǎn fàn
zh: 妈妈在厨房里做晚饭。
py: mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ zuò wǎn fàn
en: Mum is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands such as 办手续, never for food.

q: 我爸爸晚饭后喜欢坐在沙发上___电视。
zh: 我爸爸晚饭后喜欢坐在沙发上看电视。
py: wǒ bà ba wǎn fàn hòu xǐ huan zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn shì
en: After dinner my dad likes sitting on the sofa watching TV.
why: Watching television is 看电视. 读 and 念 are for reading text aloud or studying at a school, so 读电视 is wrong.

q: 老师让我们大声___课文。
zh: 老师让我们大声念课文。
py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men dà shēng niàn kè wén
en: The teacher asks us to read the text aloud.
why: 大声 means "loudly", so the verb is reading aloud: 念 (or 读). 看 is silent looking, and 写 is writing, which cannot be done loudly.

s: 他毕业以后在网上做生意，做得不错。
zh: 他毕业以后在网上做生意，做得不错。
py: tā bì yè yǐ hòu zài wǎng shàng zuò shēng yi zuò de bú cuò
en: After graduating he went into online business and is doing quite well.
why: 做生意 is the standard pair for doing business, and 做得不错 repeats the verb with 得 to describe how well he does it.

q: 我姐姐在北京___大学，学的是中文。
zh: 我姐姐在北京读大学，学的是中文。
py: wǒ jiě jie zài běi jīng dú dà xué xué de shì zhōng wén
en: My older sister is at university in Beijing, studying Chinese.
why: 读 also means to study at a school: 读大学. 看大学 would mean looking at a university, and 喝 has nothing to do with it.

q: 你感冒了，多___点儿热水。
zh: 你感冒了，多喝点儿热水。
py: nǐ gǎn mào le duō hē diǎn r rè shuǐ
en: You have a cold; drink more hot water.
why: Water is drunk: 喝水. 吃 is for food and pills, and 抽 is for cigarettes.

q: 我今天加班，回家太晚了，没有时间___饭。
zh: 我今天加班，回家太晚了，没有时间做饭。
py: wǒ jīn tiān jiā bān huí jiā tài wǎn le méi yǒu shí jiān zuò fàn
en: I worked overtime today and got home too late to cook.
why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands (办手续), never for food.

s: 我弟弟还没办作业，不能出去玩。
s_py: wǒ dì di hái méi bàn zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
zh: 我弟弟还没做作业，不能出去玩。
py: wǒ dì di hái méi zuò zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
en: My younger brother hasn't done his homework yet, so he can't go out to play.
why: Homework is 做作业. 办 is for formalities and errands, not for schoolwork.

q: 新同事今天来公司报到，要先___入职手续。
zh: 新同事今天来公司报到，要先办入职手续。
py: xīn tóng shì jīn tiān lái gōng sī bào dào yào xiān bàn rù zhí shǒu xù
en: The new colleague is reporting to the company today and must first complete the joining formalities.
why: Formalities take 办: 办手续. 做手续 does not exist, and 打 does not go with 手续 either.

q: 我昨天太累了，晚上___了一个很长的梦。
zh: 我昨天太累了，晚上做了一个很长的梦。
py: wǒ zuó tiān tài lèi le wǎn shang zuò le yī gè hěn cháng de mèng
en: I was very tired yesterday and had a very long dream at night.
why: A dream is "made" in Chinese: 做梦. 有了一个梦 sounds like acquiring a dream or an ambition, not dreaming in your sleep.

s: 外面在雨，我们别出去了。
s_py: wài miàn zài yǔ wǒ men bié chū qù le
zh: 外面在下雨，我们别出去了。
py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ wǒ men bié chū qù le
en: It is raining outside; let us not go out.
why: 雨 is a noun, not a verb. Rain "comes down", so the verb 下 is needed: 在下雨.

q: 这家饭馆的厨师很会___菜，客人特别多。
zh: 这家饭馆的厨师很会做菜，客人特别多。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de chú shī hěn huì zuò cài kè rén tè bié duō
en: The chef at this restaurant cooks very well, so there are lots of customers.
why: Cooking dishes is 做菜. 办 is for errands and formalities, and 打 is for ball games and calls.

q: 他想在城里开一家饭馆，自己___生意。
zh: 他想在城里开一家饭馆，自己做生意。
py: tā xiǎng zài chéng lǐ kāi yī jiā fàn guǎn zì jǐ zuò shēng yi
en: He wants to open a restaurant in the city and run his own business.
why: Running a business is 做生意, a fixed pair. 办生意 is not said, and 吃 cannot take 生意.

s: 我们公司五点半下班，我六点半才能到家。
zh: 我们公司五点半下班，我六点半才能到家。
py: wǒ men gōng sī wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān wǒ liù diǎn bàn cái néng dào jiā
en: Our company finishes work at half past five, and I only get home at half past six.
why: 下班 means finish work for the day, the opposite of 上班. It is correct here, and 才 stresses that getting home is late.

q: 这个问题很复杂，我还没___清楚。
zh: 这个问题很复杂，我还没搞清楚。
py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn fù zá wǒ hái méi gǎo qīng chu
en: This problem is complicated and I haven't figured it out yet.
why: 搞清楚 is the casual spoken way to say "figure out". 做清楚 and 办清楚 are not combinations Chinese uses for understanding something.

q: 孩子每天放学回家，先___作业，然后才能玩。
zh: 孩子每天放学回家，先做作业，然后才能玩。
py: hái zi měi tiān fàng xué huí jiā xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu cái néng wán
en: Every day when the child comes home from school he does his homework first and only then can he play.
why: Homework is 做作业. 办作业 is a learner error: 办 is for formalities and errands, not for schoolwork.

q: 我们公司早上九点___班，下午六点下班。
zh: 我们公司早上九点上班，下午六点下班。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zǎo shang jiǔ diǎn shàng bān xià wǔ liù diǎn xià bān
en: Our company starts work at nine in the morning and finishes at six in the afternoon.
why: Starting work is 上班, the opposite of 下班. 去班 and 来班 do not exist; you cannot go "to" 班, you start it.

s: 我每天早上七点去班，晚上六点回家。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qù bān wǎn shang liù diǎn huí jiā
zh: 我每天早上七点上班，晚上六点回家。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn shàng bān wǎn shang liù diǎn huí jiā
en: I start work at seven every morning and go home at six in the evening.
why: "Go to work" is 上班; you start a shift with 上. 去班 does not exist.

q: 铃声一响就___课了，同学们都跑去食堂吃饭。
zh: 铃声一响就下课了，同学们都跑去食堂吃饭。
py: líng shēng yī xiǎng jiù xià kè le tóng xué men dōu pǎo qù shí táng chī fàn
en: As soon as the bell rang, class was over and the students all ran off to the canteen to eat.
why: Finishing class is 下课. 上课 would mean the class begins, which makes no sense when they go off to eat, and 放课 does not exist.

q: 外面___着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
zh: 外面下着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
py: wài miàn xià zhe hěn dà de yǔ nǐ dài sǎn le ma
en: It is raining hard outside; did you bring an umbrella?
why: Rain "comes down": 下雨, with no "it" and no 是. 有着很大的雨 and 是着很大的雨 are not Chinese.

s: 他在上课，等一下再给他打电话吧。
zh: 他在上课，等一下再给他打电话吧。
py: tā zài shàng kè děng yī xià zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
en: He is in class; let us call him in a while.
why: 在上课 means he is in class right now, since 上课 covers both "class starts" and "be in class". 给他打电话 puts the person before 打.

q: 北京的冬天常常___雪，很冷。
zh: 北京的冬天常常下雪，很冷。
py: běi jīng de dōng tiān cháng cháng xià xuě hěn lěng
en: It often snows in Beijing in winter, and it is very cold.
why: Snow, like rain, takes 下: 下雪. 打雪 and 来雪 are not used for snowfall.

q: 我___决心，从明天起每天早上去跑步。
zh: 我下决心，从明天起每天早上去跑步。
py: wǒ xià jué xīn cóng míng tiān qǐ měi tiān zǎo shang qù pǎo bù
en: I've made up my mind to go running every morning from tomorrow.
why: "Make up one's mind" is 下决心, a fixed phrase. 做决心 is the English-driven error, and 上决心 does not exist.

s: 我给你寄了一条短信，你收到了吗？
s_py: wǒ gěi nǐ jì le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ shōu dào le ma
zh: 我给你发了一条短信，你收到了吗？
py: wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ shōu dào le ma
en: I sent you a text message; did you get it?
why: 寄 is for things that physically travel by post. A text message is electronic, so it takes 发.

q: 办公室的电脑不能___网，我没法发邮件。
zh: 办公室的电脑不能上网，我没法发邮件。
py: bàn gōng shì de diàn nǎo bù néng shàng wǎng wǒ méi fǎ fā yóu jiàn
en: The computer in the office cannot get online, so I can't send email.
why: Going online is 上网. 下网 does not exist, and 进网 is not used for getting online.

q: 我妹妹今年十八岁，明年就要___大学了。
zh: 我妹妹今年十八岁，明年就要上大学了。
py: wǒ mèi mei jīn nián shí bā suì míng nián jiù yào shàng dà xué le
en: My younger sister is eighteen and will start university next year.
why: Entering university is 上大学. 下大学 is wrong: finishing university is 毕业, not 下大学.

q: 我昨天给经理___了一封邮件，他还没有回。
zh: 我昨天给经理发了一封邮件，他还没有回。
py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi jīng lǐ fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn tā hái méi yǒu huí
en: I sent the manager an email yesterday and he hasn't replied yet.
why: Email is sent with 发: 发邮件. 送 is for gifts and deliveries and 问 is for asking, so neither works with 邮件.

s: 我想去邮局给老家的朋友寄一封信。
zh: 我想去邮局给老家的朋友寄一封信。
py: wǒ xiǎng qù yóu jú gěi lǎo jiā de péng you jì yī fēng xìn
en: I want to go to the post office and send a letter to a friend back home.
why: A paper letter goes through the post, so 寄 is right. The person comes before the verb with 给.

q: 这个月的工资公司已经___了，你看看银行卡。
zh: 这个月的工资公司已经发了，你看看银行卡。
py: zhè gè yuè de gōng zī gōng sī yǐ jīng fā le nǐ kàn kan yín háng kǎ
en: The company has already paid this month's salary; check your bank card.
why: Paying wages is 发工资. 寄 is for things sent by post, and 提 is for raising a question or request, not paying anyone.

q: 我想去邮局给老家的奶奶___一个包裹。
zh: 我想去邮局给老家的奶奶寄一个包裹。
py: wǒ xiǎng qù yóu jú gěi lǎo jiā de nǎi nai jì yī gè bāo guǒ
en: I want to go to the post office and send a parcel to my grandma back home.
why: A parcel sent through the post office is 寄. 打 and 提 do not mean posting something: 提 means to lift or raise, as in 提问题.

s: 老师提了一个问题，同学们都回答不出来。
zh: 老师提了一个问题，同学们都回答不出来。
py: lǎo shī tí le yī gè wèn tí tóng xué men dōu huí dá bù chū lái
en: The teacher asked a question and none of the students could answer it.
why: Here 问题 is a question: the teacher raises it with 提 and the students answer it with 回答. Both verbs fit a question.

q: 开会的时候，大家都对新办法___了很多意见。
zh: 开会的时候，大家都对新办法提了很多意见。
py: kāi huì de shí hou dà jiā dōu duì xīn bàn fǎ tí le hěn duō yì jiàn
en: At the meeting everyone made lots of comments on the new method.
why: Raising an opinion is 提意见. 寄 is only for things sent by post, and 打 is for calls, balls and injections.

q: 老师问了我一个问题，我马上___了。
zh: 老师问了我一个问题，我马上回答了。
py: lǎo shī wèn le wǒ yī gè wèn tí wǒ mǎ shàng huí dá le
en: The teacher asked me a question and I answered it right away.
why: A question put to you is answered: 回答. 解决 is for a problem that needs fixing, and 提 means raising a question, which the teacher just did.

s: 我每天早上起床以后先洗牙，再吃早饭。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān xǐ yá zài chī zǎo fàn
zh: 我每天早上起床以后先刷牙，再吃早饭。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān shuā yá zài chī zǎo fàn
en: Every morning after getting up I brush my teeth first and then have breakfast.
why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 exists but means a dentist's cleaning, so it does not fit a morning routine.

q: 电脑坏了，这个问题只有修理师傅才能___。
zh: 电脑坏了，这个问题只有修理师傅才能解决。
py: diàn nǎo huài le zhè gè wèn tí zhǐ yǒu xiū lǐ shī fu cái néng jiě jué
en: The computer is broken, and only the repairman can solve this problem.
why: Here 问题 is a problem to be fixed, so 解决. 回答 is for a question, and 提 would raise it rather than fix it.

q: 孩子昨天晚上___烧了，今天要去医院看看。
zh: 孩子昨天晚上发烧了，今天要去医院看看。
py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shāo le jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn kàn kan
en: The child had a fever last night and today we are going to the hospital.
why: "Have a fever" is 发烧. 生烧 is not said, and 寄烧 makes no sense.

q: 我们在公园玩吧，我在花旁边给你___张照片。
zh: 我们在公园玩吧，我在花旁边给你拍张照片。
py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán wán ba wǒ zài huā páng biān gěi nǐ pāi zhāng zhào piàn
en: Let's play in the park, and I'll take a photo of you next to the flowers.
why: Taking a photo is 拍照片. 拿照片 means picking up a printed photo, and 打 does not go with 照片.

s: 今年春节，我们一家人去南方度假。
zh: 今年春节，我们一家人去南方度假。
py: jīn nián chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén qù nán fāng dù jià
en: This Spring Festival our whole family is going on holiday in the south.
why: 度假 is the verb for spending a holiday somewhere and takes no object, so 去南方度假 is a normal pattern.

q: 李老师的朋友是演员，现在在上海___电影。
zh: 李老师的朋友是演员，现在在上海拍电影。
py: lǐ lǎo shī de péng you shì yǎn yuán xiàn zài zài shàng hǎi pāi diàn yǐng
en: Teacher Li's friend is an actor and is now filming a movie in Shanghai.
why: Films are shot with 拍: 拍电影. 照电影 is wrong because 照 is only for still photos, and 拿 means to hold or take.

q: 我每天早上起床后先___牙，再洗脸。
zh: 我每天早上起床后先刷牙，再洗脸。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng hòu xiān shuā yá zài xǐ liǎn
en: Every morning after getting up I brush my teeth first and then wash my face.
why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 is a dentist's cleaning, and 梳 is for hair.

s: 明天晚上我们去饭馆开生日吧。
s_py: míng tiān wǎn shang wǒ men qù fàn guǎn kāi shēng rì ba
zh: 明天晚上我们去饭馆过生日吧。
py: míng tiān wǎn shang wǒ men qù fàn guǎn guò shēng rì ba
en: Tomorrow evening let us go to a restaurant to celebrate the birthday.
why: A birthday is "passed": 过生日. 开 goes with 会, 灯 and 玩笑, not with 生日.

q: 她每天出门以前都要___头，把头发弄整齐。
zh: 她每天出门以前都要梳头，把头发弄整齐。
py: tā měi tiān chū mén yǐ qián dōu yào shū tóu bǎ tóu fa nòng zhěng qí
en: She combs her hair every day before leaving home so that it looks neat.
why: Hair is combed: 梳头. 刷头 is a learner error, and 拍头 means patting the head.

q: 今天是妈妈的生日，我们去饭馆给她___生日吧。
zh: 今天是妈妈的生日，我们去饭馆给她过生日吧。
py: jīn tiān shì mā ma de shēng rì wǒ men qù fàn guǎn gěi tā guò shēng rì ba
en: It is Mum's birthday today; let's go to a restaurant to celebrate it with her.
why: A birthday is "passed": 过生日. 开 goes with 会, 灯 and 玩笑, and 打 with balls and calls, so neither fits 生日.

s: 我每天早上七点取床。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǔ chuáng
zh: 我每天早上七点起床。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
en: I get up at seven every morning.
why: Getting up is 起床 (起 "rise"). 取 means collect or withdraw and cannot go with 床.

q: ___马路的时候，要看红绿灯。
zh: 过马路的时候，要看红绿灯。
py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou yào kàn hóng lǜ dēng
en: When you cross the road you must watch the traffic lights.
why: Crossing a road is 过马路. 开 is for driving or switching on, and 打 does not go with 马路.

q: 天气太热了，我一回家就想先___个澡。
zh: 天气太热了，我一回家就想先洗个澡。
py: tiān qì tài rè le wǒ yī huí jiā jiù xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
en: It is so hot that as soon as I get home I want to take a shower first.
why: Bathing is 洗澡. 刷 is for teeth and shoes, and 梳 is for hair, so neither fits 澡.

q: 明天早上有会，我得六点___床。
zh: 明天早上有会，我得六点起床。
py: míng tiān zǎo shang yǒu huì wǒ děi liù diǎn qǐ chuáng
en: I have a meeting tomorrow morning, so I have to get up at six.
why: Getting up is 起床. 取床 is a classic error: 取 means collect or withdraw. 站床 would mean standing on the bed.

s: 我去银行取了一千块钱。
zh: 我去银行取了一千块钱。
py: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ le yī qiān kuài qián
en: I went to the bank and withdrew a thousand yuan.
why: 取钱 is "withdraw money". 取 is the right verb for collecting what is yours, and it is different from 起 in 起床.

q: 我没带现金，得先去银行___钱。
zh: 我没带现金，得先去银行取钱。
py: wǒ méi dài xiàn jīn děi xiān qù yín háng qǔ qián
en: I have no cash on me, so I have to go to the bank and take out some money first.
why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 存 would be depositing, which is the opposite of what someone without cash needs, and 起钱 is a learner error.

q: 他每天都玩游戏，不做作业，妈妈很___气。
zh: 他每天都玩游戏，不做作业，妈妈很生气。
py: tā měi tiān dōu wán yóu xì bù zuò zuò yè mā ma hěn shēng qì
en: He plays games every day and does not do his homework, so his mum is very angry.
why: Getting angry is 生气. 起气 and 发气 are not words for being angry.

s: 她生了孩子以后，就没有再上班了。
zh: 她生了孩子以后，就没有再上班了。
py: tā shēng le hái zi yǐ hòu jiù méi yǒu zài shàng bān le
en: After she had the baby she did not go back to work.
why: 生孩子 "give birth" is the normal phrase, with 生 meaning produce. 没有再…了 says she no longer works.

q: 他昨天淋了雨，晚上就___病了，今天没来上班。
zh: 他昨天淋了雨，晚上就生病了，今天没来上班。
py: tā zuó tiān lín le yǔ wǎn shang jiù shēng bìng le jīn tiān méi lái shàng bān
en: He got caught in the rain yesterday, fell ill at night and did not come to work today.
why: Falling ill is 生病. 起病 and 留病 are not used for catching an illness.

q: 老师今天给我们___了很多作业，周末都没时间玩了。
zh: 老师今天给我们留了很多作业，周末都没时间玩了。
py: lǎo shī jīn tiān gěi wǒ men liú le hěn duō zuò yè zhōu mò dōu méi shí jiān wán le
en: The teacher set us a lot of homework today, so there is no time to play at the weekend.
why: Setting homework is 留作业 ("leave" it for them). 取 means to collect, and 生 is for producing a baby or an emotion.

s: 这杯茶太强了，我喝不下去。
s_py: zhè bēi chá tài qiáng le wǒ hē bú xià qù
zh: 这杯茶太浓了，我喝不下去。
py: zhè bēi chá tài nóng le wǒ hē bú xià qù
en: This tea is too strong; I can't drink it.
why: Strong tea is 浓 (thick, concentrated). 强 means strong in power or ability and is never used for a drink.

q: 我打算明年去英国___学，学习英语。
zh: 我打算明年去英国留学，学习英语。
py: wǒ dǎ suàn míng nián qù yīng guó liú xué xué xí yīng yǔ
en: I plan to go to Britain next year to study abroad and learn English.
why: Studying abroad is 去 + country + 留学. 生学 and 起学 are not words.

q: 晚上喝太___的茶会睡不着觉。
zh: 晚上喝太浓的茶会睡不着觉。
py: wǎn shang hē tài nóng de chá huì shuì bù zháo jiào
en: If you drink very strong tea in the evening you won't be able to sleep.
why: Strong tea is 浓茶 (thick, concentrated). 强 describes power or ability, and 重 describes weight or serious illness.

q: 这家饭馆的咖啡太___了，像水一样，没有味道。
zh: 这家饭馆的咖啡太淡了，像水一样，没有味道。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de kā fēi tài dàn le xiàng shuǐ yī yàng méi yǒu wèi dào
en: The coffee at this restaurant is too weak; it is like water and has no flavour.
why: Weak coffee or tea is 淡 (the opposite of 浓). 轻 is for light weight, and 浅 is for colours and shallow things.

s: 这场雨下得很大，路上的车都开得很慢。
zh: 这场雨下得很大，路上的车都开得很慢。
py: zhè chǎng yǔ xià de hěn dà lù shàng de chē dōu kāi de hěn màn
en: The rain is heavy, and all the cars on the road are driving slowly.
why: Rain is big or small, 大 or 小, not "heavy". 雨下得很大 is the normal way to say it is raining hard.

q: 外面雨下得很___，我们等雨小一点儿再走吧。
zh: 外面雨下得很大，我们等雨小一点儿再走吧。
py: wài miàn yǔ xià de hěn dà wǒ men děng yǔ xiǎo yī diǎn r zài zǒu ba
en: It is raining hard outside; let us wait until the rain eases before leaving.
why: Rain is 大 or 小, as the second clause 雨小一点儿 confirms. 雨下得很重 and 雨很强 are translations from English.

q: 他的病很___，医生说要住院一个月。
zh: 他的病很重，医生说要住院一个月。
py: tā de bìng hěn zhòng yī shēng shuō yào zhù yuàn yī gè yuè
en: His illness is serious; the doctor says he needs to stay in hospital for a month.
why: A serious illness is 重 (heavy). 大 is for rain, wind and sound, and 深 is for colours and impressions.

s: 昨天下了一场重雨，路上到处都是水。
s_py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng zhòng yǔ lù shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ
zh: 昨天下了一场大雨，路上到处都是水。
py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ lù shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ
en: There was a heavy rainfall yesterday and there is water everywhere on the roads.
why: Heavy rain is 大雨. 重 is for weight and serious illness, so 重雨 is a word-for-word translation from English.

q: 这件衬衫的颜色太___了，我想换一件深一点儿的。
zh: 这件衬衫的颜色太浅了，我想换一件深一点儿的。
py: zhè jiàn chèn shān de yán sè tài qiǎn le wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn shēn yī diǎn r de
en: The colour of this shirt is too light; I want to swap it for a darker one.
why: Light and dark colours are 浅 and 深, and the contrast 深一点儿 points to 浅. 轻 is for weight, and 小 is for size.

q: 这家饭馆的服务给我留下了很___的印象。
zh: 这家饭馆的服务给我留下了很深的印象。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de fú wù gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng
en: The service at this restaurant left a deep impression on me.
why: An impression is 深 (deep). 重 is for weight or illness, and 浓 is for tea and smells, not for impressions.

s: 我不喜欢太淡的茶，喜欢浓一点儿的。
zh: 我不喜欢太淡的茶，喜欢浓一点儿的。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài dàn de chá xǐ huan nóng yī diǎn r de
en: I do not like tea that is too weak; I prefer it a bit stronger.
why: 淡 and 浓 are the pair for weak and strong tea. 浓一点儿的 uses 的 to stand for 茶.

q: 房间里太吵了，请把电视的声音开___一点儿。
zh: 房间里太吵了，请把电视的声音开小一点儿。
py: fáng jiān lǐ tài chǎo le qǐng bǎ diàn shì de shēng yīn kāi xiǎo yī diǎn r
en: It is too noisy in the room; please turn the TV down a bit.
why: Volume is 大 or 小, so lowering it is 开小. 重 is for weight or serious illness and 少 is for quantity, not for sound.
